details.review_text: Synthetic public G3 three-path experience prototype fixed for Human review at package commit 51f32cafc7747d639989635ef85f99140d75b62c; decision Issue #5 (stable ID 5539933247, https://github.com/cscra/factory-control-records/issues/5) was created by yuhuan54880471 (ID 331624669) for page setup only and carries no decision authority; only a later exact decision comment by yuhuan0669 (ID 31118604) can decide G3. A valid G3 approval may freeze the reviewed interaction and information presentation and permit preparation of the G4 technical implementation plan only; it authorizes no implementation, G4-G6 result, deployment, real business use, or Control adoption, and it does not approve the G2 threshold change to 70 percent.
